change: v73: the assistant changes the length of an ET trousers file opened as it is ("裤长加 2 厘米", "裤长减 1.5 厘米") with the command of 自动改裤长 (pattern.extendPantsHem, now in the catalogue: 110 commands), once the rules are set or loaded in that panel; above the knee nothing moves, the hems move, the seams below the knee and their allowances grow by the change. The file it makes is the file the button makes, byte for byte, and the panel offers to save it as a revised PRJ copy. The scene tells a model the rules, what the file and this opening changed, the unit of its lengths and the limit; without rules, for a target length, past the limit or after a change the assistant says what is missing. Trousers the page drafted still change by pattern.updateDraft.
validation: Node tests (75 scripts and 7 other suites), 38 real-browser suites with 1955 checks. v73: made-up straight trousers were opened in ET 2017, their seams rebuilt and saved; the page opened that ET file and the assistant lengthened it by 2 cm; ET opened and saved the file the page wrote with every record where the page put it (50 records, 0.0000 mm: 38 unmoved above the knee, 4 moved 20 mm, 8 longer by 20 mm) and rebuilt its seams on the seams the page moved (140 points of the lower leg, within 0.0001 mm). Twelve instructions were put to a model for the new command (all right with the first answer) and nine again after the wording changed (all right). Every earlier comparison with ET was made again with this code, and every earlier answer of the model examination was replayed with it.
limits: v73: the assistant does not set the rules of 自动改裤长 (pieces, knee lines, hems): the patternmaker sets or loads them in the panel; a target length is not taken (the file records none); the cumulative change stays within 100 mm of the original pattern. v72: with a length (and a width) typed first the page writes the length of what it will draw, ET the length to the pointer; from ET's 要素检查 not done: kept measurements and 监控预警, 命名, 修改, 联动操作, the columns 缩水前长度 and 层间长度差, 号型模式 by 号 and 型, points measured in every size. v71: from ET's 尺寸表 dialog not done: 全局档差, 局部档差, the views 层间差 and 实际尺寸, 缩水, Excel and Word import and export, size table files, 关键词, and the second size grading by 辅助号 and 辅助型. The model was not called through the service with a key.
